12.heading: Chislothtabor:
refs: Called Chasalus by Eusebius and Jerome, and placed at the foot of mount Tabor, eight miles east of Diocesarea. Josh 19:22

Josephus, who calls this town Dabaritta, or Darabitta, places it in the plain of Jezreel, or Esdraelon, on the confines of Samaria and Galilee. It is probably the Dabira which Jerome place towards amount Tabor, in the district of Diocesarea
and the Debora or Daboura, mentioned by travellers as a village at the foot of mount Tabor. Josh 21:28 , Dabareh, 1Ch 6:72
Probably Japha, a city of Galilee, near Jotapata, mentioned by Josephus.

41.heading: Zorah:
refs: Situated on the frontiers of Dan and Judah, tens miles north from Eleutheropolis, towards Nicoplis, according to Eusebius, not far from Caphar Sorek. Josh 15:33 , Zoreah, Judg 13:2 , 25
Supposed by some to be the same as Beth-shemesh in the tribe of Judah

but this latter city is evidently distinguished from it by being assigned by the tribe of Judah to the Levites - Josh 21:16 . Ir-shemesh rendered πολις Σαμμαυς by the LXX, seems to be the same as Emmaus or Nicopolis, 22 miles south-east from Lydda, according to the Old Jerusalem Itinerary.
